annotations.title: Test store speed on a phone

description: Use this when someone asks how fast a website or online store loads on a phone, why it is slow, or how it compares with a competitor. Runs Google PageSpeed Insights (mobile lab test) on a public online store or website and explains the result in plain English: a 0 to 100 score, when the main content appears, responsiveness and layout shift, real-user data when Google has it, the third-party apps and trackers slowing the page (by name, with size and busy time), the platform (Shopify, WooCommerce and others), and the fixes ranked by time saved. Optionally tests up to two competitor sites for a side-by-side comparison. Takes 20 to 60 seconds. Only public web addresses are accepted.

competitors.description: Up to two competitor sites to test at the same time for comparison.

url.description: The store or website to test, for example "example.com" or "https://shop.example.com/products/item".

name: test_store_speed

benchmark.description: Where the score stands against the US Store Speed study

competitors.description: Competitors tested side by side, if any
